newsitem.title: USA: Knoll files for $175 mln initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: Knoll files for $175 mln initial public offering.

text.p: Knoll Inc said on Monday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a $175 million initial public offering of newly issued common stock.
The company said it expects the deal to make its debut in mid to late April. Merrill Lynch & Co., CS First Boston, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are underwriting the offering.
Knoll said it intends to use substantially all of the net proceeds to redeem a portion of its outstanding preferred stock and to repay certain indebtedness.
Knoll is a global office furnishings manufacturer and is majority-owned by Warburg, Pincus Ventures LP.
